seats._rolls_comment: "self" (default) means this player rolls their own dice, which is right for almost everyone. "dm" is an opt-out that matters to a real minority — accessibility, players who find being put on the spot stressful, players here for the story rather than the arithmetic. It lives in config rather than the GM's memory because a forgotten preference is invisible: the player is simply put on the spot and says nothing.

seats._comment: An agent seat MUST carry the literal mention its platform needs. Cues without it are accepted, posted, and never delivered — with no error. The config loader refuses this file if it is missing.

transport._write_comment: Keep false by default. Set true only for an explicitly authorized channel after the production gates in docs/TRANSPORT.md; every live caller must retain and reuse its operation_id across recovery.
transport._capability_comment: Enable MESSAGE_CONTENT in Discord's Developer Portal. The listener discovers its bot user ID from READY and fails closed if content capability is unavailable; REST is not a bypass.
transport._relay_comment: Bots that post dice on a player's behalf (Beyond20 relays D&D Beyond sheet rolls into Discord). Their messages are attributed to whichever seat's name appears in the embed, so a player who rolls all evening does not read as silent — and their roll pairs actually close. An unattributable relay is flagged, never guessed.
